prompt: Write Larkmere Mutual's document "Storm damage": the policy wording defining storm damage, and what it excludes. 120 to 220 words, in the society's own voice, as plain text with no headings or markdown. Return {"text": "..."}.
response: {"text":"Storm damage means direct physical damage to your buildings or contents caused by violent weather, such as strong winds, heavy rain, hail, sleet, snow or the weight of snow and ice. We will usually look at the weather conditions at or near the time of loss, together with the condition of the property and the likely cause of the damage. We do not cover damage that happens gradually, or because of poor maintenance, wear and tear, lack of repair, defective design, faulty workmanship or settlement, shrinkage or expansion. We also do not cover damage caused by water entering through open windows, doors or other openings, unless those openings were made by the storm. We will not pay for damage to fences, gates, hedges, paths, patios, drives, garden ornaments or other outside items unless your policy says otherwise. If the damage is caused by flood, escape of water, subsidence or ground heave rather than storm, the storm cover will not apply. Storm damage must be sudden and unforeseen, and not something that could reasonably have been prevented by normal care and maintenance."}
